runtime: Offline Python learned/classical proposal refinement, native accuracy-mode FIR design, independent final FIR checks; no runtime inference or automatic preset application.
input: 64..8192 monotonic response samples covering 20..20000 Hz; integer rate 44100..192000 Hz; target within +/-24 dB.
topology: Shared mono/stereo FIR, four peaks plus two S=1 shelves, auto gain disabled, full wet, linear phase. Exporter checks mono; preset shares one kernel across channels.
latency: Actual selected support/2 design samples +32 native partition samples; additional latency relative to saved manual support is reported in samples and ms. WAV contains design delay; its consumer adds processing latency.
remaining: Broader independent measured/noisy targets, boundary and out-of-family qualification; current eight cases are functional probes, not population acceptance.

Controlled learned-versus-strongest-classical refinement/cost comparison including cold load and up to three native preparations; FIR-aware selection is implemented, while global filter co-design is not claimed.
Application review/import and real-host/platform validation; no active preset is modified by the CLI.

candidate_selection.source: Individually qualified neural/classical proposals from optional shared-fitter payload; old single-proposal files remain supported.
candidate_selection.policy: Qualify actual native FIR and original target for every candidate; minimize resolved taps, target RMS, target maximum, stable input order.
candidate_selection.failure_behavior: Candidate conversion, native cap or final target failure does not prevent later qualified alternatives.

functional_probe_scope: Initial selected-proposal version; the later FIR-aware study is recorded under candidate_selection.
